description: Synthesize Data for Emerging Data Cleaning and Fusion Tool Link is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Automobiles", published or maintained by U.S. Department of Transportation. The Synthesize Data for Emerging Data Cleaning and Fusion Tool dataset is a privacy-preserving synthetic dataset developed to support and demonstrate the functionalities of the Emerging Data Cleaning and Fusion Tool. It replicates the general structure and statistical characteristics of real-world multimodal traffic data while ensuring that no sensitive or identifiable information is included. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Automobiles". It has 18 columns, among them dir_flag, free_speed_raw, capacity, toll, link_id, name. The portal shows 2025-11-24 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
